data.Q: Who gives the covenant copy to the king’s son?
data.A: Jehoiada gives the covenant copy to the king’s son.
data.wrong_answer: The king’s son gives the covenant copy to Jehoiada.

data.Q: Why does Athaliah go to the people at the temple?
data.A: Because she hears the guards and the people making noise.
data.wrong_answer: Because she sees the king by the pillar.

data.Q: Whom do they anoint before the cheering begins?
After Athaliah sees the king by the pillar, what does she do?
data.A: Athaliah tears her robes and calls out about treason.

data.Q: Who makes the noise that Athaliah hears?
data.A: The guards and the people make the noise.

data.Q: Who stands beside the king when Athaliah looks?
data.A: The officers and the trumpeters stand beside the king.
data.wrong_answer: The guards stand beside the king.

data.Q: After hearing the noise, to whom does Athaliah go?
data.A: Athaliah goes to the people at the temple.
data.wrong_answer: Athaliah goes to the king by the pillar.
